FN-MS4I5W1-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 142
Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Elections
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/30/2025
Senate Bill 142 as reported by the Committee on Constitutions, Campaigns and Elections would
increase the administrative obligations of: (1) the local Boards of Registrars to report to the
Secretary of State's Office the number of voters removed from voter registration lists; and (2)
the Secretary of State's Office, by an undetermined amount, to collect and publish the data
reported to the provisions of this bill.
